title: Todo rules: a title needs meaning
outcome: Predict and verify what happens when a Todo title is empty or contains surrounding whitespace.
concept: A domain invariant is a business rule that must always be true. The Todo domain trims a title and rejects it when nothing meaningful remains.

terms.meaning: A rule that must remain true whenever valid business data exists.
The part of an application that owns business concepts and rules.
Remove whitespace from the beginning and end of text.

prompt: Try a title made only of spaces. Should the application create it? Why?
hint: Imagine showing a Todo row whose title has no visible characters. What useful information would it contain?
example: The domain trims the input first. A title such as “  Buy milk  ” becomes “Buy milk”; a spaces-only title is rejected.
transfer: Which layer should own this rule: the browser, the database, or the domain? Explain your choice.
